messages.subject: /var/shiny-server/www vs./srv/shiny-server on EC2
parts:
Hey guys,

I have a quick question regarding the two directories. According to my knowledge, shiny will run all apps located in the directory of  /srv/shiny-server, however, on EC2, shiny was unable to locate the apps put in that directory, on the contrary, it finds all the apps in the directory of /var/shiny-server/www.

Another quick question is, when I turn off my Ubuntu terminal, the apps on EC2 also stopped working, is there any way to make the app continue working even after I turn off my laptop?

Thanks for your help,

Su

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: /var/shiny-server/www vs./srv/shiny-server on EC2
parts:
The 0.4.0 versions of Shiny Server look for the apps in /srv/shiny-server, while older versions (0.3.x and earlier) look for them under /var/shiny-server/www. Sorry for the inconvenience, but /var/ was simply the wrong place to put it, and we though it better to fix the problem before we hit 1.0.

If you uninstall what you have now and install from the new .deb installer then it should take care of both problems for you. Please read these instructions on upgrading first, as it's important that you uninstall the old shiny-server and upgrade the Shiny package.
